item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 30/Jun/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure over the northern part of the South China Sea, there will be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. A southwesterly airstream is expected to bring hot and showery weather to the coastal areas of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Wind: South force 3 to 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and isolated thunderstorms. Hot during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
